content.text:
All 7 tests pass now. At the start, 6 of the 7 failed. I fixed the bugs in `calc.js` one at a time, re-ran `node --test` after each fix, and left `calc.test.js` unchanged.

1. **`add`** used `a - b` instead of `a + b`, so it subtracted rather than added.
2. **`divide` by zero** had no check for a zero divisor, so it quietly returned `Infinity` instead of throwing the "zero" error the test expects.
3. **`average`** looped with `i <= nums.length`, which went one past the end of the list and added `undefined`, turning the sum into `NaN`.
4. **`average([])`** divided 0 by an empty list's length of 0, which gives `NaN`, so I made it return 0 when the list is empty.
5. **`percent`** multiplied by 10 instead of 100, so every result was 10 times too small.
6. **`roundTo`** multiplied and divided by `places` (2) instead of `10 ** places` (100), so it rounded to the nearest half rather than to 2 decimal places.
